- Search any tool from the home screen: type part of its name, what it does or its radio, accents and case aside
- PlutoSDR: found by its USB ids, so it is recognised (and USB access asked for) with ADI's firmware and with Tezuka; plugging it in offers to open the app
- Spectrum analyser, more room for the plot:
  - The header line is gone: the peak shows at the foot of the spectrum
  - Under the waterfall: move, zoom out and in, and the centre frequency to the 100 Hz; a tap on it types a frequency in a window the keyboard cannot hide
  - The marker shows its frequency to the 100 Hz, with a new button to make it the centre
  - Sliding a finger along the waterfall moves the marker, as on the spectrum
  - The spectrum and the waterfall now line up to the edges, on tablets too
- Smoother motion:
  - Long lists no longer leave their last rows blank for a moment
  - Closing a page with the back gesture no longer bounces, and reopening one while it closes no longer jumps
  - The Start/Stop button, page titles and progress bars move more smoothly
- Screen readers: icons now say what they do (Back, Close, Next…) instead of their font names, and icon buttons are announced as buttons
- The confirmation message sits lower inside tools and can be tapped away
